skill.name: teach-impeccable
skill.description: Collects project design context, asks focused UX questions, and saves persistent guidance for future AI-assisted design work.
skill.summary: Creates durable design guidance from codebase evidence and user answers.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: The three static findings are false positives caused by inline and fenced markdown backticks in SKILL.md. I found no prompt injection attempt, data exfiltration intent, or executable command path in the reviewed file. The skill does ask the assistant to write design context to local project files, which matches its stated setup purpose.

static_findings.snippet: Synthesize your findings and the user's answers into a `## Design Context` section:

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 49 uses inline markdown backticks around a section title. There is no Ruby expression, shell command, or executable code path.
Lines 51 through 65 are a fenced markdown example that shows the desired Design Context format. The backticks delimit documentation and do not execute commands.
Line 65 closes the fenced markdown example. This is static documentation syntax, not Ruby backtick execution.

content.value_statement: AI design work often loses project context across sessions. This skill gathers evidence and saves reusable guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Reviews README files, documentation, package files, configuration files, components, brand assets, tokens, and style guides.
Asks focused UX questions only for details that cannot be inferred from the project.
Organizes findings into users, brand personality, aesthetic direction, and design principles.
Writes or updates a Design Context section in `.impeccable.md` at the project root.
Can optionally update the configured AI guidance file after user confirmation.
limitations: Quality depends on the available project files and the user's answers.
It does not create a complete design system or component library.
It needs permission to write local project guidance files.
The saved guidance should be refreshed when product or brand direction changes.

use_cases.title: Onboard a Product Team
use_cases.description: Capture audience, brand, and interface expectations before new AI-assisted product work begins.

use_cases.title: Guide Frontend Implementation
use_cases.description: Give coding agents durable design rules before they modify components, layouts, or visual styles.

use_cases.title: Preserve Brand Direction
use_cases.description: Record design references, anti-references, accessibility needs, and principles for repeated project sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Design Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a project without saved design guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use teach-impeccable to scan this project, ask only missing design questions, and create the Design Context section.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Existing Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Update guidance after product or visual direction changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use teach-impeccable to update the existing Design Context after reviewing recent project changes and asking for missing decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Redesign
prompt_templates.scenario: Align an AI coding agent before a focused UI redesign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use teach-impeccable before a redesign. Compare the current interface, brand assets, and component patterns before writing updated guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Stakeholder Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use when several inputs must become durable design rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use teach-impeccable to reconcile codebase evidence, stakeholder answers, anti-references, accessibility needs, and design principles into durable project guidance.

output_examples.input: Run setup in a SaaS dashboard project with existing components and unclear brand direction.
output_examples.output: A Design Context section describing operations users, calm visual tone, restrained components, and practical principles for dense workflows.

output_examples.input: Refresh guidance after the team decides to support dark mode and reduce animation.
output_examples.output: An updated context section that records theme preferences, motion constraints, accessibility expectations, and revised design principles.

output_examples.input: Prepare an AI agent before it builds a new marketing settings page.
output_examples.output: A saved design brief that tells the agent which patterns, colors, spacing, and interaction style to follow.

best_practices: Run the skill before major UI work so design guidance is available from the start.
Answer missing context questions with concrete users, references, constraints, and anti-references.
Review the saved Design Context after generation and update it when direction changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a replacement for user research or design review.
Do not leave vague answers such as modern, clean, or friendly without examples.
Do not keep stale guidance after the product audience, brand, or accessibility needs change.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Design Context section with users, brand personality, aesthetic direction, and design principles.

faq.question: Where does it save the guidance?
faq.answer: It saves the guidance in `.impeccable.md` and can update the configured AI file after confirmation.

faq.question: Does it inspect the project first?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews docs, configuration, components, assets, tokens, and style guides before asking questions.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it make design decisions automatically?
faq.answer: No. It infers available context and asks the user to clarify missing design choices.

faq.question: When should I run it again?
faq.answer: Run it again when the audience, brand direction, accessibility requirements, or product goals change.
